run_convert_checkpoint: run the upgrade_model_version script to convert an old MMDetection checkpoint to the latest version
run_upgrade_retina_model: run the upgrade_model_version script to upgrade a RetinaNet model checkpoint from V1.x to current format
run_upgrade_rpn_model: run the upgrade_model_version script to upgrade an RPN model checkpoint trained before MMDetection v2.5.0
run_convert_two_stage_detector: run the upgrade_model_version script to convert a two-stage detector checkpoint by renaming head keys to roi_head prefix
run_convert_ssd_checkpoint: run the upgrade_model_version script to convert an SSD model checkpoint with reordered classification channels
